01 /

Start an account conversation

Sign in, open the support chat and choose a topic or type your question. The account assistant can explain your balance, recent payment requests, verification status, stakes and copy positions.

02 /

Ask for an administrator

Choose Talk to admin in the chat to request a handover. Unsupported questions and requests to change account records also go to the administrator queue. Replies appear in your conversation; no response time is guaranteed.

03 /

Help us find the right activity

Include the payment request, transaction or stake reference, what you expected, and what you see instead. Keep the conversation focused on your own account.

  • Never send your password, email verification code or full card details.
  • Upload identity documents only through the verification page, not support chat.
04 /

Having trouble signing in?

Use the email address registered on your account, check your spam folder for the code and request a replacement after the resend timer ends. If you used the wrong address, select Use another account on the code screen.
